chips: Am I on track for the house?
What happens when the fund is full?

answers.Am I on track for the house?: Yes — £6,400 of £24,000, £320 each payday, on course for 2031. The rate stays 5.1% while the plan holds.
answers.What happens when the fund is full?: The £40 rule stops itself at £5,000. My suggestion — point it at the house; that brings 2031 about three months closer. Your call, and I’ll ask again when it happens.
answers.Show me my receipts: Every automated move sits in your feed as an ordinary row — 14 to the house pot so far, each with its receipt attached.
answers.A person, please: Of course. A named person picks this up with your context already in front of them — no phone tree, no starting over. Usually under two minutes at this time of day.
